Sector modules

What each industry module includes.

15 modules
  • 01 Forwarders, transporters, 3PLs

    Logistics & Freight

    • Rates, quotations and shipments — FCL/LCL, air and road
    • Containers, customs workflow, transport and drivers
    • Warehouse, POD, job costing and customer portal

    Why it's different · Profitability per job, not per month.

  • 02 Agencies and DMCs

    Travel & Tourism

    • Travel CRM, quotations and bookings
    • Flights, hotels, transfers, attractions and visas
    • Suppliers, refunds and booking profitability
  • 03 Importers, wholesalers and distributors

    Trading & Distribution

    • Price lists, customer pricing and quotations
    • Orders, stock, delivery and returns
    • Receivables, supplier bills and margin analysis
  • 04 Brokerages and property managers

    Real Estate

    • Listings, units, owners, tenants and agents
    • Leads, viewings, sales and leases
    • Rent, commissions, maintenance and portals
  • 05 Contractors and fit-out firms

    Construction & Contracting

    • Tenders, estimates, budgets and procurement
    • Subcontractors, labour, site, equipment, quality and safety
    • Variations, progress billing and costing
  • 06 FM providers

    Facility Management

    • Contracts, sites and assets
    • Preventive maintenance, work orders and SLA
    • Technicians, parts, field app and billing
  • 07 Consultancies and firms

    Professional Services

    • CRM, projects and time
    • Contracts, billing and documents
    • Client portal
  • 08 Agencies and in-house teams

    Recruitment

    • Clients, jobs and candidates
    • ATS, interviews and placements
    • Documents and billing
  • 09 Stores and chains

    Retail

    • POS, inventory and purchasing
    • Pricing, promotions and loyalty
    • E-commerce and delivery
  • 10 Workshops, dealers and rentals

    Automotive

    • Vehicles and customers
    • Service and repair jobs, parts and warranty
    • Sales and rentals
  • 11 Hotels and restaurants

    Hospitality

    • Reservations, guests and rooms
    • Housekeeping and restaurant POS
    • Inventory, staff and billing
  • 12 Schools and training centres

    Education

    • Admissions, students and classes
    • Attendance, faculty and fees
    • Parent and student portals
  • 13 Small and mid-size plants

    Manufacturing

    • BOM, planning and work orders
    • Materials, production and quality
    • Maintenance, costing and traceability
  • 14 Clinics and medical groups

    Healthcare Administration

    • Appointments and patient administration
    • Billing, inventory, staff and procurement
    • Clinical systems kept separate

    Why it's different · Administration only — clinical records stay in clinical systems.

  • 15 Online sellers and brands

    E-commerce

    • Catalogue, checkout and payment gateways
    • Orders, fulfilment, returns and refunds
    • Inventory and finance posting in one flow
